svg.title: Claude Code using mmgrep to find mail that still needs a reply
svg.desc: A user asks Claude Code which mails from last week still need a reply. Claude loads the mmgrep skill, runs one mmgrep query and answers with two mails that need a reply, each with what the sender asked, and one that possibly does.
svg.text: ❯ which mails from last week still need a reply from me?
● Two mails from last week still need a reply from you:
Their order is on hold until you confirm the new terms. She asks
which plan applies and whether you can sign by Friday.
2. Bob Lee (Example Corp), October 23rd: "Slow connection issue"
He can reproduce it and asks how to collect the logs.
Possibly: Erik Holm (October 19th) sent the decisions from your
planning call. No question in it; reply only if you disagree.
The other 35 are receipts, alerts, calendar updates and thank-yous.
